ImageDescription.value: This image, acquired by one of the Copernicus Sentinel-2 satellites on 1 November 2022, shows Lake Atanasovsko, a 5km long salt coastal lake in Bulgaria. Lake Atanasovsko is known for the diversity of its bird population, composed of many endangered species. The northern part of the Lake is a natural reserve connected by a canal to the Black Sea, while the southern part has been used as a salt production facility for more than a century.
